scenarios.title: Rocket roadster roll + pitch
scenarios.idea: Tesla Roadster does a rocket-thruster aerial maneuver off a ramp: a full 360-degree roll AND a full 360-degree pitch rotation, landing upright on its wheels
scenarios.tagline: Can a 1.3 t car roll AND pitch a full 360 deg off a ramp on cold-gas thrusters and land upright?

scenarios.title: Humanoid jump
scenarios.idea: A Unitree G1 humanoid robot jumps 0.15 m straight up and lands on its feet without falling
scenarios.tagline: Can a Unitree G1 jump 0.15 m and land without falling? Turn the motor torque down and watch the verdict change.
